rawMessage: In HPE OCA / CLIC on DL380a Gen12, 339778-B21 (HPE RAID 1 Drive 1 FIO Setting) strictly enforces Drive Count == 2. When >2 drives (e.g. 4x NVMe SSDs) are configured without a full-cage RAID 5/10 setting, CLIC marks the build as UNBUILDABLE (Action-Required) due to unassigned drive geometry mismatch and mandates 389692-B21 (HPE Customer Defined RAID Setting Service, max 1) or omitting FIO settings when dedicated NS204i-u boot device P78279-B21 is present.

HPE NS204i-u v2 480GB Boot Device (P78279-B21) and front boot cage (P75284-B21) have zero hardware, cage, or bus dependency on SFF data drives (P63833-B21 / P50219-B21 / P50216-B21), 4SFF drive cage (P74710-B21), or direct-attach cables (P74702-B21). Boot tier and data tier can be configured independently or together.

DL380a Gen12 base CTO chassis P76706-B21 does not bundle rack rails. When customer tender requests installation, racking, and cabling, P69770-B21 (Ball Bearing Rail Kit) is mandatory to mount the 4U chassis. Furthermore, SFP28 networking adapters (P10115-B21) require 2x 845398-B21 (25Gb SFP28 SR Transceivers) or DAC cables to prevent site cabling failure.
